approach: Add a `StewardRequest` builder in steward.rs with private fields and a validating constructor (needs at least one non-blank acceptance bullet and one path-like file). Route `structural_text`, `design_review_text` and `RequestQueue::apply` (introspection follow-ups, blind spots) through it. Extract the plan_entry request-text parse in reading.rs into two pub functions that plan_entry calls, so tests run the real parse. Parser behaviour is unchanged. Dedupe already ignores Closed jobs; add doc fix and reopen test. Reword design-review body lines that start with `1.` or `- ` so they are not read as acceptance.

decisions.choice: One builder type with private fields and a validating constructor in steward.rs
decisions.reason: The constructor enforces the format, so a new writer cannot skip it; tests cover every writer.

rejected.why: Nothing stops a writer skipping it.

decisions.choice: Extract pub request_text_acceptance and request_text_touches in reading.rs, called by plan_entry
decisions.reason: Tests use exactly the parse athena plan uses.

decisions.choice: Derive acceptance and files for model-written requests in RequestQueue::apply via StewardRequest::from_change, with default bullets
decisions.reason: Keeps ProposedChange shape, avoiding edits outside deliverables.

rejected.why: Breaks constructors in tests and changes the model schema.

decisions.choice: Leave structural_pass_open logic; prove with a test
decisions.reason: It already treats JobState::Closed (rejected, failed, abandoned) as not open.

rejected.option: Treat plan-refused Queued jobs as not open

files.purpose: Add StewardRequest (new, from_change, priority, render); route RequestQueue::apply and blind_spot_change through it; validate_item rejects requests naming no file; add all-writers and builder tests.
Build structural_text and design_review_text through the builder; reword review body lines; document and test closed-pass dedupe; add bullet and reopen tests.
Extract pub request_text_acceptance and request_text_touches from plan_entry's unread-request branch, behaviour unchanged; looks_like_path pub(crate).
At most a small test helper or doc touch; no parser change.
Only if needed; likely a doc line, since follow-ups reach the queue via ProposedChange.request.
Unreleased entry for the steward request format fix and the dedupe test.

steps: Read table_text in code_health.rs, source_names() in steward.rs and the steward prompt text.
In reading.rs extract request_text_acceptance and request_text_touches from plan_entry, call them there, make looks_like_path pub(crate).

In steward.rs add StewardRequest with private fields and validating new, from_change, priority, render; check results with request_text_*; route RequestQueue::apply and blind_spot_change through it; reject no-file requests in validate_item.

Rewrite structural_text: first line Structural pass: <path>; body with measured numbers; bullets per breach with limits, no behaviour change with existing tests passing, fmt/clippy/test pass; files = [path].
Rewrite design_review_text through the builder: priority high, bullets, files docs/design/; reword numbered and dashed body lines.
Update structural_pass_open doc; add reopen-after-close and structural-bullets tests.
Add all-writers and builder tests in steward.rs.
Add CHANGELOG.md entry; run fmt, clippy and test; fix fallout.

risks.risk: Existing tests queue steward requests like "Make the change." with no file.
risks.mitigation: Run steward and drain tests; use default acceptance and the source path as fallback so only a request with no derivable file is rejected.

risks.risk: Body lines starting with -, * or 1. are read as extra acceptance.
risks.mitigation: Test that parsed acceptance equals the builder's bullets for structural pass and design review.

risks.risk: The plan_entry refactor changes plan behaviour.
risks.mitigation: Pure extraction; existing plan_entry tests must pass unchanged.

risks.risk: looks_like_path misses a Files: word such as a directory without slash.
risks.mitigation: Use paths with a slash (docs/design/); tests use the real function.

demonstrations.method: New test in steward.rs builds each writer's text (structural pass, design review, RequestQueue::apply with an introspection-style request and a blind-spot change) and runs it through reading::request_text_acceptance and request_text_touches, plus PlanEntry::missing().
demonstrations.observes: Each text yields at least one acceptance bullet and a non-empty file list; missing() does not contain acceptance.
demonstrations.fails_without: A writer omitting Acceptance bullets or files gives empty acceptance or touches, so missing() contains acceptance and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: New test in code_health.rs builds a FileHealth fixture breaching lines, function length and weekly landings, calls structural_text.
demonstrations.observes: An Acceptance: section whose bullets name each limit with its measured value, say no behaviour change with existing tests passing, and fmt, clippy and test pass; a Files: line names the path.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the bullets, limit numbers or Files line, the assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: New test in code_health.rs runs the hook on a landed big file, closes the queued job with the close_job helper, runs the hook again.
demonstrations.observes: The second run queues a new structural job for the same path, different from the first.
demonstrations.fails_without: If closed passes counted as open, the second run queues nothing and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: Builder unit tests in steward.rs: new returns Err for empty acceptance, blank bullets, empty files or multi-line title; render always contains Acceptance: and Files:. The all-writers test covers every caller.
demonstrations.observes: Constructor errors for each missing part; valid input renders both sections.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the builder accepted empty acceptance or files the constructor tests fail; if a writer bypassed it the all-writers test fails.

demonstrations.method: Run the existing open-request dedupe test together with the new reopen test.
demonstrations.observes: An open pass suppresses a duplicate and a closed pass does not.
demonstrations.fails_without: If an open pass stopped suppressing, structural_pass_queues_nothing_for_a_file_with_an_open_request fails; if a closed pass counted as open, the reopen test fails.

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks; the new tests are part of the suite.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All exit 0, including the new writer, bullet and reopen tests.
demonstrations.fails_without: Unformatted code fails fmt; any warning fails clippy; a writer lacking acceptance or files, a missing bullet, or a dedupe that ignores closing fails the new tests under cargo test.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the diff for a new Unreleased entry.
demonstrations.observes: Entry says steward requests carry an Acceptance: section and Files: line via one shared builder, the structural-pass bullets, and the reopen-after-close dedupe.

open_questions: Athena::queue in reading.rs writes channel "cli" though the brief says steward channel; the drain works both, so the channel is left as is.
source_names() in steward.rs must be checked: a non-path blind-spot source needs a fallback file such as records/.
The steward prompt may need a line asking for bullets and files; default bullets cover its absence.
Plan-refused passes stay Queued and count as open until a person closes them, as the brief assumes.
